description: The Environment Agency produced the Flood Zones layer of the Flood Map for Planning, which shows land in England at present-day risk of flooding from rivers and the sea, ignoring the benefit of defences: Flood Zone 1 below a 0.1 percent annual probability, Flood Zone 2 between 0.1 and 1 percent from rivers (0.1 to 0.5 percent from the sea), and Flood Zone 3 above those. It replaced the separate Flood Zone 2 and 3 datasets, retired in 2025, and a Flood Zones plus Climate Change layer is published alongside. Coverage is England. The data are a free download as a file geodatabase, GeoJSON or GeoPackage, or through WMS and WFS, under the Open Government Licence v3.0, with a product description. Caveats: the zones ignore the benefit of defences, and the page does not state an update frequency. Simulation uses: river and sea flood extents for exposure of water assets and siting decisions. Related records: the EA flood defence assets (data-ea-aims-spatial-flood-defences) and reservoir flood extents (data-england-reservoir-flood-extents).
